Jeremy Lips & Dave Brody Stargazing doesn't have to be expensive; the Celestron Cometron 7x50 binoculars sit at an entry-level price point (now even cheaper for Black Friday) and offer closer views of those beautiful stellar structures you can see in the sky.

They are a great pair for getting beginners into night sky observation or even just as an extra pair for wide-field observation of constellations and the Milky Way. The magnification is low enough that you will be able to keep them steady without a tripod and their wide exit pupil assures bright, immersive views of star fields.

The Cometron binoculars were already cheap and we would recommend them even when not on sale, but getting them with 25% off is incredible value for such a useful tool. Get ready for Black Friday on Nov. 27, as we are likely to see more deals on skywatching equipment and cameras as the big day approaches.
